name: Mama Love! 2 ~Ore no Kanojo wa Ore no Mama ☆ Sewayaki Kyonyuu Rio-mama~
original_name: ママラブ！2 ～俺の彼女は俺のママ☆世話焼き巨乳凛桜ママ～
source:
The protagonist, Akiyuki, is in the height of puberty and just needs to have sex! However, confession after confession ends in rejection.

Right at the start of the summer vacation, things take a sudden turn when his mother, Rio - unable to bear the sight of her sulking son - drops a single bombshell.

"I'll be your girlfriend for the summer!"

Even if it comes with caveats, the protagonist gets fired up at the prospect of having a girlfriend.

As he's "disciplined" with a mix of carrot and stick, can he really end up having sex with his mother?!

[Translated from the [url=https://www.hs-crowd.co.jp/anim/product/pro_pc/pc093/index.html#story]official website[/url]]
translation:
主角秋之正值青春期，正值性爱的巅峰！然而一次又一次的表白却以拒绝告终。

暑假刚开始，事情突然发生了转变，他的母亲里奥无法忍受儿子生闷气的样子，扔下了一颗重磅炸弹。

“我就当你夏天的女朋友吧！”

即使有警告，主角也会因为有女朋友的前景而兴奋不已。

在胡萝卜加大棒的“管教”下，他真的能和妈妈发生关系吗？！

[翻译自[url=https://www.hs-crowd.co.jp/anim/product/pro_pc/pc093/index.html#story]官网[/url]]
